name: Correct grammar and phrasing in multiple languages
description: Users asked for grammar, spelling, and clarity corrections for sentences and texts in multiple specific languages, including French, Korean, Russian, German, Portuguese, and Persian. Some requests also involved explaining linguistic nuances, such as honorifics, punctuation rules, or natural phrasing, to improve the appropriateness and style of the writing.
